description: List the objects a session holds (%instances): each with its id, type and lifetime, the ones a later instantiation displaced included.

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: instances

displacedFrom.description: the name a later instantiation took from it

life.description: destroyed or ended when its lifetime is over

name.description: the name %instantiate created it under; empty for an object a later instantiation displaced

type.description: qualified name of what it instantiates
